{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the unique values in 'channel'
channels = sales['channel'].unique()
print(f'Unique channels: {channels}')

# Check the data types and sample
print('\nData types:')
print(sales.dtypes)

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print(f'\nNumber of -1 in customer_age: {sales[sales["customer_age"] == -1].shape[0]}')

# Check revenue column for string format
print(f'\nSample of revenue (as string): {sales["revenue"].head().tolist()}')

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'\nNumber of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {qa_orders.shape[0]}')

# Check refund status
refunded = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f'\nNumber of refunded orders: {refunded.shape[0]}')"}
